items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Well I worked with Eddie Condon, oh, many times... And I tell you, he and I worked together with Eddie -- Eddie Condon.

ctx.x: Now Red, you're talking about Red Richards now.
Yeah, right. So Saints and Sinners, and who else did I go with? Oh, I went in there -- at Cleveland, I went in there with Eddie --
